시편-90-1.title: 시편 90장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-1.exegesis: 38-52. present a striking contrast to these glowing promises, in mournful evidences of a loss of God's favor. cast off-- and rejected (compare Psa 15:4 ; 43:2 ; 44:9 ).
시편-90-1.theologicalNote: 38-52. present a striking contrast to these glowing promises, in mournful evidences of a loss of God's favor. cast off-- and rejected (compare Psa 15:4 ; 43:2 ; 44:9 ).

시편-90-2.title: 시편 90장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-2.exegesis: PSALM 90 Psa 90:1-17 . Contrasting man's frailty with God's eternity, the writer mourns over it as the punishment of sin, and prays for a return of the divine favor. A Prayer [mainly such] of Moses the man of God--( De 33:1 ; Jos 14:6 ); as such he wrote this (see on Psa 18:1 , title, and Psa 36:1 , title). 1. dwelling-place-- home (compare Eze 11:16 ), as a refuge ( De 33:27 ).
시편-90-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 90 Psa 90:1-17 . Contrasting man's frailty with God's eternity, the writer mourns over it as the punishment of sin, and prays for a return of the divine favor. A Prayer [mainly such] of Moses the man of God--( De 33:1 ; Jos 14:6 ); as such he wrote this (see on Psa 18:1 , title, and Psa 36:1 , title). 1. dwelling-place-- home (compare Eze 11:16 ), as a refuge ( De 33:27 ).

시편-90-3.title: 시편 90장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-3.exegesis: 2. brought forth [and] formed-- both express the idea of production by birth.
시편-90-3.theologicalNote: 2. brought forth [and] formed-- both express the idea of production by birth.

시편-90-4.title: 시편 90장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-4.exegesis: 3. to destruction-- literally, "even to dust" ( Ge 3:19 ), which is partly quoted in the last clause.
시편-90-4.theologicalNote: 3. to destruction-- literally, "even to dust" ( Ge 3:19 ), which is partly quoted in the last clause.

시편-90-5.title: 시편 90장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-5.exegesis: 4. Even were our days now a thousand years, as Adam's, our life would be but a moment in God's sight ( 2Pe 3:8 ). a watch-- or, third part of a night (compare Ex 14:24 ).
시편-90-5.theologicalNote: 4. Even were our days now a thousand years, as Adam's, our life would be but a moment in God's sight ( 2Pe 3:8 ). a watch-- or, third part of a night (compare Ex 14:24 ).

시편-90-6.title: 시편 90장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-6.exegesis: 5-6. Life is like grass, which, though changing under the influence of the night's dew, and flourishing in the morning, is soon cut down and withereth ( Psa 103:15 ; 1Pe 1:24 ).
시편-90-6.theologicalNote: 5-6. Life is like grass, which, though changing under the influence of the night's dew, and flourishing in the morning, is soon cut down and withereth ( Psa 103:15 ; 1Pe 1:24 ).

시편-90-8.title: 시편 90장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-8.exegesis: 7-8. For-- A reason, this is the infliction of God's wrath. troubled-- literally, "confounded by terror" ( Psa 2:5 ). Death is by sin ( Ro 5:12 ). Though "secret," the light of God's countenance, as a candle, will bring sin to view ( Pr 20:27 ; 1Co 4:5 ).

시편-90-10.title: 시편 90장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-10.exegesis: 9. are passed-- literally, "turn," as to depart ( Jr 6:4 ). spend-- literally, "consume." as a tale-- literally, "a thought," or, "a sigh" ( Eze 2:10 ).

시편-90-11.title: 시편 90장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-11.exegesis: 10. Moses' life was an exception ( De 34:7 ). it is ... cut off-- or, "driven," as is said of the quails in using the same word ( Nu 11:31 ). In view of this certain and speedy end, life is full of sorrow.
시편-90-11.theologicalNote: 10. Moses' life was an exception ( De 34:7 ). it is ... cut off-- or, "driven," as is said of the quails in using the same word ( Nu 11:31 ). In view of this certain and speedy end, life is full of sorrow.

시편-90-12.title: 시편 90장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-12.exegesis: 11. The whole verse may be read as a question implying the negative, "No one knows what Thy anger can do, and what Thy wrath is, estimated by a true piety."
시편-90-12.theologicalNote: 11. The whole verse may be read as a question implying the negative, "No one knows what Thy anger can do, and what Thy wrath is, estimated by a true piety."

시편-90-13.title: 시편 90장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-13.exegesis: 12. This he prays we may know or understand, so as properly to number or appreciate the shortness of our days, that we may be wise.
시편-90-13.theologicalNote: 12. This he prays we may know or understand, so as properly to number or appreciate the shortness of our days, that we may be wise.

시편-90-14.title: 시편 90장 14절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-14.exegesis: 13. (Compare Psa 13:2 ). let it repent-- a strong figure, as in Ex 32:12 , imploring a change in His dealings.
시편-90-14.theologicalNote: 13. (Compare Psa 13:2 ). let it repent-- a strong figure, as in Ex 32:12 , imploring a change in His dealings.

시편-90-16.title: 시편 90장 16절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-16.exegesis: 15. As have been our sorrows, so let our joys be great and long.
시편-90-16.theologicalNote: 15. As have been our sorrows, so let our joys be great and long.

시편-90-17.title: 시편 90장 17절 역사문법적 주해
시편-90-17.exegesis: 16. thy work-- or, providential acts. thy glory-- ( Psa 8:5 ; 45:3 ), the honor accruing from Thy work of mercy to us.
시편-90-17.theologicalNote: 16. thy work-- or, providential acts. thy glory-- ( Psa 8:5 ; 45:3 ), the honor accruing from Thy work of mercy to us.
